_comment: Known Amazon US sales-event windows. Amazon announces exact dates each year — ALWAYS confirm against the actual data (max event-day with a spend spike) before trusting these. Dates are inclusive [start, end]. For non-US marketplaces, confirm locally; events often differ by country.

defaults._baseline_comment: Baseline = the N days ending `baseline_gap_days` before the event start (avoids pre-event ramp bleeding into the run-rate). For Prime Day, a 3-day baseline ending the day before the event works well.
defaults._kw_low_comment: Keywords below this spend are excluded from the 'lowest performing' list so noise doesn't crowd out real waste.
